Title: Accessible Component Library with Automated Audit Tooling
Problem Statement: Design systems ship dozens of interactive components, but accessibility regressions slip in between releases because manual audits do not scale. Build a React component library where every component ships with automated axe-core assertions, keyboard-interaction tests, and a CI gate that blocks merges introducing WCAG violations, plus a dashboard that tracks the accessibility debt of a codebase over time.

Title: Offline-First Field Data Collection App for Rural Health Workers
Problem Statement: Community health workers in low-connectivity regions record patient visits on paper because existing apps assume a live connection. Build a progressive web app with local-first storage, conflict-free sync when connectivity returns, and a compact form engine so supervisors can push new survey definitions without an app-store update.

Title: Quantum-Assisted Portfolio Rebalancing under Transaction Costs
Problem Statement: Portfolio rebalancing with cardinality and transaction-cost constraints is a mixed-integer problem that classical solvers handle poorly at scale. Investigate whether QAOA or a hybrid quantum-classical solver produces competitive rebalancing schedules versus a commercial MIP solver on historical index data, and characterise where the quantum approach helps and where it does not.
